title: An Agent-based Model to Evaluate Interventions on Online Dating Platforms to Decrease Racial Homogamy
reasoning: The paper's core research question is ethically motivated, as it evaluates the effectiveness of technological interventions aimed at mitigating a societal ill—racial homogamy—which is framed as a driver of racial inequality. The study is an exploration of the ethical responsibility and capability of platforms to foster more equitable social outcomes.
